description: This file defines the class `AOTIModelContainerRunnerXpu`, which is a specialized implementation of a model container runner for XPU devices within the Torch Inductor project. It declares constructors, destructors, and methods for running models on XPU hardware, and includes relevant external headers and dependencies.

classes.name: AOTIModelContainerRunnerXpu
classes.description: A class that extends the `AOTIModelContainerRunner` to support XPU devices, providing methods for model inference on XPU hardware.

methods.name: AOTIModelContainerRunnerXpu
methods.description: Constructor to instantiate the XPU-specific model container runner with model path, device information, and threading options.

methods.name: ~AOTIModelContainerRunnerXpu
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up the XPU model container runner.

methods.name: run_impl
methods.description: Executes the model with given input handles and stream handle, returning output tensors.

methods.name: run_with_xpu_stream
methods.description: Runs the model using a provided XPU stream and input tensors, returning output tensors.
